proposed.explanation: Uniform light from all sides includes uncontrollable heat gain from the West. Both have the same WFR (1:10), so both comply with the minimum area requirement. Code does not require windows on all sides; it only requires a total area relative to the floor. Design B follows passive cooling principles by placing windows on the North/South sides, which are easier to shade, while avoiding the harsh East/West solar heat gain. Passive design favors North-South orientation for glazing in the Philippines.
